## Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] I reproduced this on the latest release or current `main`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests.
- [ ] I am authorized to share all included URLs, content, logs, and screenshots.
- [ ] This is not a security vulnerability. I will use `SECURITY.md` for security reports.
